subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'** i.e. **'reincarnation'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 5 is** "reincarnation".**
 
• **The context** of the sentence suggests that Salvador Dali was told that he was his brother's **"reincarnation".**
 
• The **concept of reincarnation** refers to the philosophical or religious belief that an individual's soul is reborn in a different body after death.
 
• The **idea here is** likely that Dali was considered a reincarnation of his deceased brother.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'Salvador Dali was a prominent Spanish surrealist painter born in Figueres, Catalonia, on 11 May 1904. Dali's father was strict in the education of his children unlike his mother. Dali had a brother named Salvador who was born nine months before him and died of gastroenteritis. When he was five. Dali was taken to his brother's grave and was told that he was his brother's **reincarnation**.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Here's why the other options don't fit:
 
 
• **"Ordination"** refers to the act of conferring holy orders or religious authority, which is not suitable here.
 
• **"Detonation" **refers to an explosion, which does not fit the context.
 
• **"Stagnation" **refers to a state of no growth or activity, which also doesn't fit the context.
